name: Orora Limited
summary: Orora Limited designs, manufactures, and supplies packaging products and services in Australasia, Europe, and internationally. It also provides aluminum cans, such as aluminium cans including classic cans, sleek cans and can ends; glass bottles, including beer, wine, cider and alcoholic ready-to-drink styles, carbonated soft drinks, juices, olive oil, spirits, as well as custom designs and innovative glass bottle sleeving; and saverglass which offers glass for wines and spirits. Orora Limited was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Hawthorn, Australia.
